name: 도로롱 전체 구조 탐색 V2
status: architecture and geometric reach study; not fabrication CAD or walking validation
user_direction: Prioritize physical feasibility and reference silhouette; size and price are not current optimization constraints. Preserve quadruped walking, biped walking, self-righting and external power/pull measurement.

rear_each.note: hip roll/pitch, knee, ankle pair large; hip yaw medium. Ankle pair would drive a coupled two-axis linkage, not two independent motors with a fixed ratio.

front_each.note: shoulder pitch and elbow large; shoulder roll medium

transmission_screen.note: Torque/speed transformations and tight-minus-slack belt force only; no belt width, life, preload, tooth count, bearing or thermal qualification. Ankle coupled-linkage Jacobian is not designed.

ankle_linkage.status: first closed-chain geometry, not released CAD
ankle_linkage.scope: Two rigid rods and circular crank endpoints around parallel y axes; neutral crank angle zero defines rod length separately for each candidate. Foot orientation Ry(pitch)Rx(roll). Housings are reference cylinders. Rod-to-housing clearance only; bearings, crank/rod joints, full gimbal, shafts, other limbs and all-pairs collision omitted.

sources.title: Disney: Design and Control of a Bipedal Robotic Character
sources.evidence: Physical character robot: 0.66m, 15.4kg, five axes per leg, rounded compliant feet without active ankle roll. Evidence of character-oriented biped mechanics; not a quadruped or this design.

sources.title: Open Dynamic Robot Initiative: modular torque-controlled robot
sources.evidence: Built low-ratio brushless belt-driven actuators and legged robot. Supports the transmission principle; does not validate our belt dimensions, loads or ankle linkage.

sources.title: CubeMars AK70-9 V3 manufacturer specifications and comparison table
sources.evidence: AK70 dimensions, rated and peak torque, speed, mass and voltage; comparison table also contains AK45-10 V3. Manufacturer declarations, not independent measurements.

sources.title: CubeMars AK60-6 V3 manufacturer specifications
sources.evidence: Dimensions, mass, rated/peak torque, speed and voltage. Manufacturer declaration; no motor selected.

not_validated: Detailed actuator packing and mounting: the reach model uses ideal intersecting axes, not full motor housings.

Full-range ankle feasibility and full mechanical interference; a sampled first rod/crank mapping is calculated, but bearing/gimbal design, stiffness, play, thermal load and continuous trajectories remain unverified.
All-pairs collision of links, head/body covers, motor housings, cables and mounts.
Whole-body dynamics, ground contact stability, walking, stance transitions, self-righting trajectory and hardware transfer.
Shell shapes and mass allocations are assumptions; no manufactured parts, load tests or material selections.
